<!-- Code generated by xgen. DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!-- Source: xgen/screens/src/authoring/blocks/work.ts -->
<!--
  Projects of a studio or a person: cards with tags and links, a compact grid, tiles with the caption over the
  picture, a bento with one big project, or a list beside a collage. Axes: layout (cards, compact, overlay,
  bento, list), tone, density.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Project, ProjectLabels } from "./project-grid.types";

  export type ProjectGridProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    lead?: string;
    projects: Project[];
    labels: ProjectLabels;
    layout?: "cards" | "compact" | "overlay" | "bento" | "list";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    density?: "default" | "compact";
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Box from "../primitives/box/box.svelte";
  import Group from "../primitives/group/group.svelte";
  import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../primitives/text/text.svelte";
  import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.svelte";
  import ProjectTiles from "../components/project-tiles.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    lead = "",
    projects,
    labels,
    layout = "cards",
    tone = "default",
    density = "default",
  }: ProjectGridProps = $props();
</script>

<SectionFrame
  id={id}
  title={title}
  lead={lead}
  tone={tone}
  density={density}
  layout={(((layout as string) === "list") ? "split" : "stack")}
  media={{ show: ((layout as string) === "list"), align: "start" }}
>
  {#if ((layout as string) === "list")}
    <Stack gap="4" align="stretch" data-testid="items">
      {#each projects as p (p.id)}
        <Group gap="4" align="start" class="border-b border-border pb-4" data-testid="item">
          <MediaFrame alt={p.title} ratio="1/1" class="size-16 shrink-0" />
          <Stack gap="2" align="stretch" class="flex-1">
            <Group gap="4" justify="between">
              <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
                {p.title}
              </Text>
              <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
                {p.year}
              </Text>
            </Group>
            <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
              {p.summary}
            </Text>
          </Stack>
        </Group>
      {/each}
    </Stack>
  {:else}
    <ProjectTiles projects={projects} labels={labels} layout={layout} />
  {/if}
  {#snippet aside()}
    <Box class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4" data-testid="collage">
      <MediaFrame alt={title} ratio="3/4" />
      <MediaFrame alt={title} ratio="3/4" class="mt-8" />
    </Box>
  {/snippet}
</SectionFrame>
